_note: Static wiki reference data: every Heart Event by villager, for the Reminders window's real Heart Events section (under Available Events). Not memory-derived. villager_id is the game's own confirmed Internal ID (data/tables/villagers.json's 'id' field, data/pointer_map.md's 'NPC/Villager relationship struct' section). Only the 12 marriage-candidate villagers have this colored sequence; everyone else in villagers.json has non-colored 'Townsfolk Events' instead, or none, and is intentionally omitted here. 'url' is that villager's Romance Events page on stratswiki.com; all rows for a villager share the same value since the wiki covers a villager's whole event sequence on one page. Rebuilt from all 12 individual wiki pages after an earlier version was found to be missing an entire event per villager and to mislabel the first colored event as 'Gray' instead of 'Black' -- caught live: testing Popuri, her Heart Event Triggered counter read 1 (only the untracked 'meeting' event fired) and the event actually playing out (Your Farm, Mon-Sat, 6am-12pm) didn't match anything in the old table at all. The real sequence per candidate is 8 events, not 7: an uncolored 'meeting' event (0 LP) that's the FIRST row here (color 'Black 1'), then 'Black 2' (a second, distinct black-tier event -- the wiki calls it 'Friend 1'), then Purple/Blue/Green/Yellow/Orange/Red as before. All 8 rows ARE tracked by the live Heart Event Triggered counter (+0x3C, data/pointer_map.md) -- confirmed live: it starts at 0, and after N of these 8 rows have fired (in order, row 0 first) the counter reads exactly N. So the index into a villager's 8 rows here is simply the counter value itself (0-based) -- no off-by-one adjustment needed. A counter of 8 means every row has fired. 'trigger_type' is 'schedule' (gated below by day-of-week/weather/season) or 'gift' (Green Confession / Red Proposal -- give 'gift_item' whenever the player chooses; neither needs a day/time reminder, and Reminders skips both entirely rather than showing them). 'days_mode' ('any'/'only'/'exclude') + 'days' (weekday names, meaningful only when days_mode isn't 'any'). 'weather_required' (true only for an explicit 'sunny weather' requirement). 'season_mode'/'season' (Kai's whole sequence only fires in Summer -- 'only' -- while Popuri's Purple/Blue explicitly exclude Summer -- 'exclude'; both real, live-checked against info.season). Three more REAL, live-checked gates, each confirmed against the wiki and NOT just left as caveat text: 'min_date' (null, or {year,season,day} -- event only available once game_calendar.day_index(now) is strictly greater than that date; e.g. Cliff's Purple requires the Winery Event, Yr 1 Fall 15, to have already happened), 'excluded_dates' (a list of {season,day}, year-agnostic/repeats every year -- e.g. Cliff's Blue never fires on Fall 5, any year), and 'other_villager_fp_min' (a list of {villager_name,min_fp} -- ALL listed villagers' live Friendship (+0x10, same field the Villager Reminders section already reads) must be at or above min_fp -- e.g. Cliff's Yellow needs Yu/Mei/Popuri each at 150+ FP). A 4th real gate, 'requires_met' (a list of villager names), reflects that 'met at least once' is itself a live, permanent flag (+0x1B, the Status field's 4th packed byte, same field Talked/Gifted already come from) -- ALL listed villagers must have it set, e.g. Elly's Black 2 needs Jeff already met, her Purple needs Ellen already met, her Yellow needs Mei already met; once a prerequisite has a real 'requires_met' entry its old freeform 'already met X' special text is dropped as redundant. All four gates default to null/[]/[]/[] when unused. 'special' is a freeform extra condition that still can't be auto-checked (an NPC's own presence -- separate from ANY prior meeting with them, since presence is real-time and can't be read the same way -- stamina, livestock owned, tool equipped, a specific excluded date not worth its own excluded_dates entry, etc.) -- shown as a caveat in the reminder text, never gates availability itself. Two more refinements: (1) 'requirements' (the display string) no longer includes the day-of-week or weather clause -- both are already live-gated above, so showing them was pure redundancy; time-of-day is kept since it's shown but never gated (no exact-clock-time check). Season notes ('Summer only', 'Not available during Summer') are kept since that's context beyond a simple pass/fail. (2) 'dialogue_choice'/'dialogue_lp' -- the best (highest-LP) dialogue option during the event itself, from each candidate's own wiki page; every schedule-type event across all 12 candidates confirmed at a flat +3000 LP, matching pointer_map.md's own '+3000 on a Black Heart Event' example. null for gift-type rows (a single gift action, not a dialogue tree). Rendered as the last part of 'requirements': 'Option - "<choice>" (+<lp> LP)'. All of this was derived from each villager's own stratswiki.com romance-events page, then corrected per-candidate where the wiki text alone was ambiguous (see e.g. Brandon/Cliff's 'special' text and Cliff's three new real gates above). A second pass re-checked every dialogue_choice across all 12 candidates against each option's FULL effects (not just LP for the target villager), since a tie in LP between options can still be broken by a difference in other-villager FP that isn't otherwise tracked in this table. Popuri's Blue event was the one real miss -- "I think Popuri's right." and "You two are upsetting Lillia." are both +3000 LP, but only the latter avoids a Rick FP -10 penalty (Lillia FP +20 either way); corrected. Every other candidate's existing dialogue_choice already matched that event's highest-LP option, with FP used only the same way (as a tie-break among equal-LP options), never overriding LP. Ran's Blue event also has an EARLIER, separate dialogue prompt (about Dudley being present) that affects only Dudley's FP, before the LP-bearing second prompt this table tracks as 'dialogue_choice' -- not worth its own schema field, so it's folded into 'requirements' as plain text instead ('Earlier prompt: ...').
